proposal.summary: GitLab CE/EE versions 14.7 < 14.7.7, 14.8 < 14.8.5, and 14.9 < 14.9.2 set a hardcoded password for accounts registered via an OmniAuth provider (e.g., OAuth, LDAP, SAML), allowing attackers to potentially take over accounts.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab CE/EE 14.7 prior to 14.7.7, 14.8 prior to 14.8.5, 14.9 prior to 14.9.2
proposal.cwe_quote: A hardcoded password was set for accounts registered using an OmniAuth provider (e.g. OAuth, LDAP, SAML)

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify affected GitLab versions in your environment, immediately update to the patched versions listed by GitLab, and rotate credentials and review accounts created via OmniAuth providers for unauthorized access.
